title: Traumatic brain injury and concussion in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the head injury (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/18/2026
Reason for Admission: Fall from a ladder resulting in a traumatic brain injury.

Hospital Course:
The patient is a 36-year-old woman who presented to the emergency department following a fall from a ladder. She was unconscious for approximately 10 minutes at the scene. Initial imaging revealed a diffuse axonal injury on MRI. She was admitted to the neurosurgical intensive care unit for observation and management of neurological deficits. During her stay, she showed steady improvement in cognitive function and motor coordination. She remained stable throughout the remainder of her stay and was cleared for discharge once she achieved functional milestones.

Discharge Diagnoses:
- Traumatic brain injury
- Diffuse axonal injury

Discharge Medications:
- Levetiracetam 500mg twice daily
- Acetaminophen 650mg as needed for pain

Follow-up:
The patient will follow up with neurology in one week for a repeat neurological exam and to monitor her progress.

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, MD, 05/18/2026
explanations: Diffuse traumatic brain injury with loss of consciousness of 30 minutes or less, initial encounter: S06.2X1A (HCC 398).

distractors.why: There was a brief loss of consciousness.

hccs.label: Major Head Injury with Loss of Consciousness < 1 Hour or Unspecified
